study.question: Does the current balanced, separate-field target query add predictive utility to the complete pooled_observed model beyond a matched context query and active-capacity recombination of already pooled evidence?
study.hypothesis: Within-match-group category/context and brand/context event associations may carry incremental predictive information absent from pooled_observed summaries. Preserve the entire stronger source and add the current target readout via a zero-final-initialized residual head on inherited shared features plus the norm-matched d-vector. Utility must beat both frozen source bests, especially pooled_observed. A target-query advantage over the identical active-capacity context-query cell supports only incremental query utility in this fusion; superiority over active learned recombination of existing group means and uniform duplicated evidence is also required for an event-readout complementarity interpretation. Shared ancestry and the absence of locally supplied query-control outcomes make redundancy a serious alternative.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit the complete predictor, including independent moments and identity/context/repeat/overlap/chronological-transition/global pooled-product observed-gap branches. Add an event retrieval residual without replacing its existing representation or widening its existing MLP.

Reuse its target versus history-context queries, separate category/brand reads, equal occupied-match-group mass, score architecture and norm matching, but fuse into the stronger complete source with an appended zero-final residual rather than the earlier smaller shared MLP. This is an operational combination, not a verified new architecture family.

DIN already supplies target-conditioned learned history pooling. Original DIN explicitly abandons softmax to retain intensity; this field-adapted inherited source uses separate softmaxes within match groups, equal group mass and norm matching. No exact DIN reproduction or priority claim.

The participant table contrasts cross-attention query generation and attention removal in another task/split. Here no learned query generator, token bridge, multi-view expansion or claimed transfer: first establish whether the existing target read adds utility to the stronger pooled predictor with capacity and evidence controls.
Author README confirms category, brand and behavior type without item IDs. No item embeddings, negatives, auxiliary labels or claimed DMR reproduction. Publisher full paper remains unavailable.

inherited_components: Unmodified source model classes and all original parameters, allocation order, frozen config switches and parent forward arithmetic from g1-r0019-pooled_observed
Five exact source helpers from g3-r0007-balanced_target: _encode, _score, _weights, _group_weights and _match_norm; separate read algebra adapted only to an explicit learned flag
Reuse the parent's allocated but dormant 4226-parameter attention scorer, without reinitialization; all four cells allocate the same parameters
Frozen meta/batch interface; no model I/O, labels, optimizer changes, extra events, data preprocessing or new supervision
study.proposed_difference: Append a bias-free 32-unit ReLU residual head to [inherited shared features, 16-dimensional readout]; zero its final weight only after every parent allocation. Keep parent output plus all six existing residual branches exactly. Cell target uses the current balanced target read; context replaces only target embeddings as query with global per-field history means while target-match memberships stay fixed; uniform zero-scales the same scores, duplicating the already available equal-occupied-group average of summed pools; pooled_duplicate actively scores and mixes the four existing summed group means with the same two target queries and shared scorer, then norm matches. The latter introduces no event-level evidence and retains active scorer capacity, but changes key/value granularity and between-group normalization together, so it is a replacement control, not a single-factor query contrast. All four share head shape, allocated parameter order and initial parent function. The candidate is mechanism-distinct from either frozen source through simultaneous prediction from the full pooled representation and event-level retrieval; novelty remains unverified.
predictions: Primary utility: target full-population validation ROC-AUC exceeds both 0.6302753100663608 (pooled_observed) and 0.6202303848951921 (balanced_target) under the frozen full protocol; Logloss must also be reported.
Conditioning: target minus context paired-seed AUC is positive; its failure leaves target-query utility unsupported even if the fusion improves.
Evidence/capacity: target outperforms active pooled_duplicate as well as uniform. Gains reproduced by these controls support capacity/reuse rather than incremental event evidence.

Label-free diagnostics reproduce the parent logits before the new residual, verify norms, mass, padding/empty/zero-length handling, and exhibit equal-parent synthetic histories with potentially different event readout. These checks are implementation evidence, not causal evidence of prediction benefit.

Report actual parameters, wall/train time, peak memory and full validation throughput/batch p50/p95 latency. Increased cost is expected; make no equal-compute efficiency claim from a matched-data-pass comparison.
falsifiers: No gain over pooled_observed, or any apparent gain fails paired repetition: incremental utility remains unsupported for this implementation.
Context matches/exceeds target: no support for the specifically target-query mechanism. Match grouping remains target dependent in both cells.
Pooled_duplicate or uniform matches/exceeds target: extra active capacity or existing evidence suffices; do not claim new event-level complementarity.
Parent reproduction, padding, finite forward/backward or information-boundary checks fail: execution/implementation failure, not scientific refutation.
Host cost exceeds trial cap or repetition reserve: retain receipt and stop/reduce future scope without altering the fixed protocol or budget.
alternative_explanations: Shared representations already encode the useful signal; the two source scores do not establish complementarity.
Extra head capacity or activating the formerly dormant scorer explains gains; context and active pooled_duplicate address this, while uniform matches allocation but has a zero-gradient scorer.
Scratch optimization, zero-final residual warm-up, validation checkpoint selection or seed noise changes performance without the hypothesized information gain.
Pooling-control between-group normalization and reduced key support can affect optimization; allocated and nominal active scorer counts do not prove equal effective capacity.
Norm matching controls magnitude but can remove useful intensity or amplify near-zero vectors; fallback rate and norm errors are measured.

Short/empty histories and rare behaviors have limited sample support; static snapshots have undocumented as-of dates; event histories are truncated at 128. No production causal validity or cross-task transfer is established.

cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve 13500s for validation-only paired repetitions of target, closest query/duplicate controls and both frozen sources, targeting seeds 42,43,44; reuse matching committed seed-42 receipts only. A prospective five-model final suite would require ten additional seed-43/44 units after this round; use measured costs and current ledger before scheduling. No test access or withheld assessment is requested.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Do not run training in propose phase. Host owns execution and budget. Stop on actual remaining-budget/trial-cap limit, failed integrity checks, or when no useful admissible contrast fits after reserves. Never alter epochs/history/data/scorer or raise a cap. Freeze source/config/checkpoint comparison suite before any later assessment; current assessment scope is validation only.
